card.text: Sub-Neptune 2.6 times Earth’s radius, in the habitable zone of a red dwarf.

introduction.text: K2-18 b is 2.6 times as wide as Earth and circles its red dwarf every 33 days. Its size, mass, orbit and atmosphere are observed; here it is a plain gray sphere.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A gray sphere of the measured radius. No colour or surface is observed; its atmosphere is observed in transmission.
